title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP!
body: WARNING: Stay away from ReadShort! This app feels like a complete scam! They make it incredibly easy to charge your credit card but almost impossible to cancel your subscription. There is no clear or accessible way to stop recurring payments, and the entire cancellation process is ridiculously frustrating. It honestly feels like they are more interested in taking your money than providing a legitimate service. I strongly recommend that you DO NOT download this app or give them your credit card information! Customers should not have to jump through hoops just to stop being charged for something they no longer want. Save yourself the headache and your money. STAY AWAY!

title: It’s a good app so far but some changes need to be made
body: The stories are great, but canceling the subscription is unnecessarily confusing because the app gives you incorrect instructions. For anyone trying to cancel, here’s how to do it: 1. Go to My Wallet. 2. Click Subscription History. 3. Select Subscription Management. 4. From there, you can cancel your subscription. I hope this helps anyone having trouble canceling! The app really needs to make this process clearer and provide the correct instructions.
